jak-enhanced-light.description: New lighting and graphics for the game as it is: real-time sun and shadows, ambient occlusion, reflections on water and wet streets, rain, fog, sandstorms and a night sky, HD pause maps, and an in-game menu to tune it all (F1). Gameplay is untouched. The single-game version of Jak Enhanced Trilogy (the full one, with the three games in one program, is on GitHub).
